correctness.rationale: Exact indicator algebra establishes all-size means and second moments. Independent methods directly enumerate each survivor set and calculate union-size moments using exact rational arithmetic for all 1600 degree-sorted legal matrices at total size up to 7, and assert their equality at all survivor counts. Complete finite profile maximization certifies the first failure. The exceptional four-by-three case has a simple structural proof and exact variance vectors; limits beyond seven total species are explicitly unproved.

value.rationale: Stage-conditioned fluctuation risk is ecologically motivated because the expected robustness curve is identical for networks with the same secondary degrees, while catastrophic simultaneous losses are not. The exact first-system-size obstruction establishes a sharp boundary for any attempt to assign a universally most volatile topology, and its star-versus-double-edge switch demonstrates that risk depends on removal stage even at equal degree and equal expected losses.
